name: Dakine
notes: Store meta: Torrance, California, USD, ships to 54 countries incl. US, CA, GB (https://dakine.com/meta.json). About: 'Founded in Hawaii in 1979 and located at the base of Mt. Hood in Hood River, Oregon'; started on Maui's North Shore making surf leashes (https://www.dakine.com/pages/about-us).

Free ground shipping over $99, excluding oversized items and HI/AK (https://www.dakine.com/policies/shipping-policy). 30-day returns of unused items, $10.95 flat return-shipping fee; sale items not returnable (https://www.dakine.com/policies/refund-policy).

Counted only lifestyle, laptop and travel backpacks, totes, crossbodies and hip packs; snow, ski, snowboard, surf and luggage bags excluded. Named: Jive Crossbody $29 ('Our popular Jive purse'), Campus Backpack 25L $75 ('Our best-selling backpack', padded laptop sleeve, insulated pocket, body 85% recycled polyester), Campus Backpack 33L $86, Grom Backpack 2.0 13L $55.
